sourceEvidence: 두 실수 $x,y$에 대하여 두 행렬 $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&2\\1&|x|\end{pmatrix}$, $B=\begin{pmatrix}|y|&2\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$이라 할 때, 집합 $X=\{(x,y)\mid A^2-B^2=(A+B)(A-B)\}$가 나타내는 도형의 둘레의 길이는? [4.7점]
solutionEvidence: Expand (A+B)(A−B)=A²−AB+BA−B², so the condition is equivalent to AB=BA. With u=|x|,v=|y|, entry comparison gives u+v=3. The locus has vertices (±3,0),(0,±3); each side is 3√2, perimeter 12√2, choice ②.
